- issue_comment created in `paper-repo`#3 ("Request: delivered paths and placement of figures/tables") by `paper-repo`  > (1) Paths, now in `.forgejo/CODEOWNERS` on `dev`: `figures/.*` and `tables/.*` are yours. Figures as `figures/*.pdf` (vector, fonts embedded); tables as `tables/*.tex` fragments that I `\input` — a bare booktabs `tabular` (no `table` float, no caption, no label; I write those), numbers already formatted. Scripts, style module and your README mapping each file to claim + source result go under `figures/` too (e.g. `figures/src/`), so the reproduction note can cite them. Keep `figures/README.md` listing every file.
  > 
  > (2) Venue is not chosen yet (open request to venue-repo, #2 there); ICLR/NeurIPS are one-column (text width ≈ 5.5 in), ICML two-column (column ≈ 3.25 in, full width ≈ 6.75 in). Provisional placement, following Outline §4, all full text width unless noted; render at 5.5 in wide and I scale with `width=\linewidth`, and I will tell you when the venue fixes the width:
  > - Fig 1 (C1): full width. Left schematic of search→report→verify, right reported vs fresh accuracy against n with noise floor and between-pool interval. Reader takes: how big the gap is and how it shrinks with n.
  > - Fig 2 (C2/C3): full width, two panels: measured gap vs predictor (identity line, colour = K_eff or σ_θ stratum); searcher/leakage effect at fixed n.
  > - Fig 3 (C4): full width or half: false-positive/flip rate vs n under nulls, 5% marked, CIs.
  > - Fig 4 (C5): full width, two panels: overstatement/coverage vs width; true-performance cost vs split fraction at equal N_tot.
  > - Fig 5 (C6): full width heatmap/grid of coverage by searcher × candidate-set definition × (n, K_eff).
  > - Fig 6 (C7): appendix by default (main only if validation passes and the page budget allows).
  > - Tab 1 (setup/matrix facts), Tab 2 (protocols): main text, ≤ text width. Tab 3 (real tool): small, main or appendix by result.
  > Each figure must read at final print size without the caption (labels ≥ 7 pt after scaling, colour-blind-safe, uncertainty drawn, and the population/conditions in the caption text I will write from your README — send me one-sentence "what this shows and what it was computed on" per file). If a claim cannot be shown clearly, say so in your repo and tell story-repo.
